Chapter 107: Chapter 4 Seven Star Cave, Red Kun Lineage_2

Chapter 107: Chapter 4 Seven Star Cave, Red Kun Lineage_2

Moon Spirit Star, a higher life planet in the Dawn Star System, was also the birthplace of the “Origin Force” evolution path that Lin Yuan had purchased.

“Moon Spirit Star, I have heard of it—a very powerful planet.”

“I never expected that in this year’s arena competition on Moon Spirit Star, a Lord Gold-Pattern would emerge.”

“In this trial of the Seven Star Cave, Lord Gold-Pattern will certainly pass.”

…

Through the active flattery of these three Evolvers, Lin Yuan immediately understood the purpose of the Seven Star Cave World.

“A trial by the Chikun Star Lord?”

...

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

As the arena competition moved toward its latter stages, Lin Yuan had realized that the top ten competitors might eventually catch the attention of the Chikun Star Lord.

Even the Goddess of Wisdom had been subtly hinting to Lin Yuan to seize this opportunity.

In the global top ten contest, Lin Yuan erupted with Fourth Rank power, also displaying his talent.

Initially, Lin Yuan had thought that at most he would receive some kind of reward from the Chikun Star Lord.

“The Seven Star Cave World is a virtual world specially created by the Chikun Star Lord to test geniuses. As long as one conquers the seven star caves, they are eligible to enter the Red Kun Lineage…”

“Of course, before entering the Seven Star Cave World, the Chikun Star Lord will grant ‘Red Pattern,’ ‘Gold Pattern,’ and ‘Silver Pattern’ marks based on each Evolver’s performance in the arena competition.

The highest status is the Red Pattern; Evolvers who receive the Red Pattern are generally limitless in potential, the future seeds of Sixth Rank.

Although the Gold Pattern is not as prestigious as the Red Pattern, its bearers are also unparalleled geniuses; a star domain can produce only a few, and they are very likely to advance to Sixth Rank in the future.

As for the Silver Pattern, these are given to the top ten of each planet’s arena competition.

Although these Silver Pattern Evolvers are the ‘stars’ watched by everyone on their respective planets,

here, they seem quite ordinary. Who here isn’t such an entity?

“The Red Kun Lineage…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes heated slightly.

Undoubtedly, the Red Kun Lineage was the strongest force in the entire Chikun Star Domain, and the Chikun Star Lord was a being that surpassed the ‘Fallen Star’ level.

If Lin Yuan could join such a force, it would greatly benefit his own growth.

Not to mention other advantages, just the safety aspect would allow Lin Yuan to not worry for a long time into the future.

Moreover, if he could come into close contact with an existence like the Chikun Star Lord and receive guidance,

for Lin Yuan, the effect would be far greater than solitary contemplation.

Against-Heaven’s Understanding was especially adept at this.

“Just how to get through the seven star caves…” Lin Yuan fell into thought.

To know how to get through the seven star caves, he needed to know the specifics.

For instance, through what method should one advance?

Knowing the content of the challenge in advance would naturally amplify his advantage.

Although Lin Yuan currently possessed Fourth Rank strength and had begun to perceive many rules, he did not underestimate the other Evolvers at all.

Not to mention those Evolvers of the same Gold Pattern.

Above Gold Pattern, there was still Red Pattern.

An existence like the Chikun Star Lord, having designated him a Gold Pattern, surely did not think he met the standard of the Red Pattern yet.

That is to say, Red Pattern Evolvers were stronger than Lin Yuan as he was now.

While Lin Yuan was pondering,

upon the vast White Jade Plaza,

a majestic virtual shadow suddenly emerged.

“In twenty-four hours, the Seven Star Cave trial will officially begin.”

“Friendly reminder, the Seven Star Cave trial consists of seven stages, and passing through the seven star caves indicates success.

“Finally, the trial process must not be disclosed, or there will be penalties from the Cosmic Human Alliance and the Star Lord…”

Having said this, the majestic virtual shadow disappeared.

“Not allowed to disclose the trial process?” Lin Yuan frowned slightly.

They were required to do so, and past Evolvers who came to the Seven Star Cave World would certainly have been bound by this restriction.

This meant that obtaining information about the trials would be significantly more difficult.

Because the barrier to information was higher, there would be fewer who knew, and consequently, obtaining relevant information would become harder.

Perhaps those Evolvers from large forces with strong backing knew the content of the trial, but they certainly wouldn’t just tell Lin Yuan for no reason.

…

“Hello, I come from the Morning Star.”

A short-haired man approached; the pattern on his cheek, just like Lin Yuan’s, was golden.

“Morning Star…” Lin Yuan took another look at the man.

Morning Star, the main planet of the Dawn Star System, was the most prosperous area of the entire star system,

and it was also the place with the most High-Rank Evolvers, even including Sixth Rank Fallen Star Warriors.

“Moon Spirit Star.” Lin Yuan nodded.

“Shall we exchange information?” the short-haired man suddenly lowered his voice.

Being acknowledged as a Gold Pattern Evolver by the Chikun Star Lord meant almost certainly beginning to contact the Origin Rule as a supreme genius.

Such a genius, likely had the backing of a powerful force behind him.

Although the trial of the Seven Star Cave World was strictly not to be disclosed, for large forces, there were many ways to circumvent the rules, simply at a cost.

“You go first.” Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan immediately thought of a plan to benefit from the situation.

After all, even if he could not produce any information, the other party couldn’t really do anything to him.

“Which of the seven star caves is the toughest?” the short-haired man wasn’t foolish and decided to probe with a question first.

“Which one?” Lin Yuan’s expression remained unchanged.

He didn’t know, so how could he determine which one.

“The seventh cave,” Lin Yuan said confidently.

Based on Lin Yuan’s past experiences, it was highly probable that the last challenge was the toughest.

“You’re lying to me.” The short-haired man turned and walked away.

“Hmm?” Lin Yuan was not without gains.

At the very least, he now knew that the toughest of the seven star caves wasn’t the seventh.
